matrix.name: Greetings / natural conversation / multi-turn context
matrix.details: Greeting prefix in compound sentence ('Chào bạn, mình muốn tour 3 quán quanh Hồ Gươm tối nay trong120phút,ngân sách500nghìn cho2người') routes to pure greeting intent; parsed tour patch is completely discarded, leaving all preference slots as 'Chưa chọn'.

matrix.name: Vietnamese attached/word numbers, group/per-person budgets, people/stops, duration vs max-per-leg
matrix.details: Attached numbers without spaces fail regex tokenization: 'tour3 quán' leaves Số quán as 'Chưa chọn'; 'nay120 phút' leaves Buổi as 'Chưa chọn'. Word numbers ('ba quán', 'hai người') parse correctly.

matrix.name: Place / GPS allowed / denied / manual
matrix.details: Hoàn Kiếm quick chip works; however landmark 'Chợ Đồng Xuân' in natural query failed to resolve to Hoàn Kiếm / Phố Cổ area without explicit district mention.

matrix.name: Preferences / negation / allergies + edit / reclarify
matrix.details: Allergy 'đậu phộng' preserved in UnderstoodCard; honest disclaimer banner displayed; negation ('không ăn cay, không thịt bò') respected; UnderstoodCard inline edit updates party size from 2 to 3.

matrix.name: Confirmation / create tour / no-solution / explicit user relaxation only
matrix.details: 1000đ budget triggers no-solution warning without tour creation; standard S0 flow displays ConfirmSummaryCard, confirms via 'confirm-yes-btn', and creates 3-stop timeline.

matrix.name: Replace / locks / stale 409 / repeated replacement
matrix.details: Clicking 'stop-replace-btn-0' opens ReplaceDiffModal with tour locking notice; clicking 'Thay quán này' replaces stop #1 from '[SYNTHETIC] Chè Thử 12' to '[SYNTHETIC] Kem Thử 24' while locking stops #2 and #3.

matrix.name: Reset / new session / restore / reload / back navigation
matrix.details: Page reload mid-flow restores state from GET /v1/sessions/{id}; clicking 'Làm lại' (↻) button successfully resets session and returns to empty start screen.

matrix.name: Loading / rapid sends / timeout / offline / backend errors / provider errors
matrix.details: Long message (3000 characters) and prompt injection string (<script>alert(1)</script>) handled gracefully with Vietnamese error notice, no raw JSON, no script execution.

matrix.name: Free Google Maps URL stop order / mode / split route, no API / billing
matrix.details: Free Google Maps walking URL (https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&...&travelmode=walking) generated with correct stop order; 0 paid Google Maps API requests; 0 billing dependencies.

matrix.name: Visible controls, scroll, keyboard / focus, desktop 1440x1024 and mobile 390x844
matrix.details: Desktop 1440x1024 scrollWidth=1425 (no horizontal scroll); Mobile 390x844 scrollWidth=390 (no horizontal scroll); tab switching between 'Khám phá' and 'Lịch trình' works cleanly.

matrix.name: Live Gemini Provider & Quota
matrix.details: Effective positive evidence verifies health.llm='mock', health.llm_provider='rules', llm_budget=null on both 8020/8040. No live Gemini provider endpoint configured. Key access and config mutation prohibited.

matrix.name: Private Backend (Port 3020 / 8020) Functional Health
matrix.details: Tested real UI 3020 against real private backend 8020; UnderstoodCard renders 10 item rows; zero private venue data, coordinates, or addresses stored in Git/reports.

bugs.title: Attached numbers without spaces fail stop and day_part extraction
bugs.steps: Type: 'tour3 quán quanh Hồ Gươm tối nay120 phút,500nghìn cho2người,thích phở và bún chả,dị ứng đậu phộng'
bugs.expected: Số quán = 3, Buổi = Buổi tối / Tối nay
bugs.actual: Số quán = Chưa chọn, Buổi = Chưa chọn

bugs.title: Picking clarification chip 'scope:group' leaves chat.pending: null and causes UI dead-air
bugs.steps: Send S0 prompt -> UI presents '500.000 đ là ngân sách cho cả nhóm hay cho mỗi người?' -> Click 'Cả nhóm'
bugs.expected: Backend advances to next missing slot (e.g. start_time/vehicle) or initiates tour proposal
bugs.actual: Backend returns text-only reply 'Đã cập nhật: ngân sách tính cả nhóm.' with chat.pending=null; UI clarifyCard disappears and no next question or tour is shown

bugs.title: Budget inline editor only provides preset chips without free-form numeric input
bugs.steps: In UnderstoodCard, click 'Sửa' on Ngân sách row
bugs.expected: Input modal or field allowing arbitrary budget amount (e.g. 700k, 350k)
bugs.actual: Only 4 preset chips appear (200k, 300k, 500k, 1 triệu) with Lưu/Huỷ

bugs.title: Greeting prefix in compound sentence drops all parsed tour request slots
bugs.steps: Type: 'Chào bạn, mình muốn tour 3 quán quanh Hồ Gươm tối nay trong120phút,ngân sách500nghìn cho2người'
bugs.expected: UnderstoodCard populated with Hồ Gươm, 120 phút, 500k, 2 người, 3 quán
bugs.actual: Entire tour request dropped; backend routes solely to greeting reply; all UnderstoodCard rows remain 'Chưa chọn'

bugs.title: Landmark 'Chợ Đồng Xuân' fails to resolve to Hoàn Kiếm / Phố Cổ area
bugs.steps: Type: 'Tour quanh Chợ Đồng Xuân 90 phút ngân sách 200k một người'
bugs.expected: Origin or Area resolved to Chợ Đồng Xuân / Hoàn Kiếm
